mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in unemployment rate and rise in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises > 50k in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint signal triggers in more than 10% of cases but fails to produce positive 20d returns in over 60% of those instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.7 million units signals strong housing demand, which acts as a leading indicator of consumer confidence and aggregate demand, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is not significantly positive in periods when HOUST > 1.7 million (t-test p > 0.05), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 index level indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening economic momentum and potential recession risk, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the average 5d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate signals disinflationary monetary policy, which increases real interest rate uncertainty and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 3 months while FEDFUNDS remains unchanged
failure_condition: The interaction signal triggers in more than 15% of cases but fails to predict negative 20d returns in over 60% of those instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 350 billion dollars signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is not significantly positive when RSAFS > 350B (t-test p > 0.05), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls indicates labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 50k in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint signal triggers in more than 10% of cases but fails to produce negative 20d returns in over 60% of those instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.6 million units signals weakening residential investment, which acts as a leading indicator of reduced consumer confidence and aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1.6 million, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
